note: The Celtics' season opens tonight against the Pistons.

front.title: Apple confirms October 28 'Pro and Tell' launch event
front.tldr: Apple will unveil a second wave of new products on 28 October in an event called 'Pro and Tell,' following its 13 October 'Welcome Home' announcement. It won't be a traditional keynote.

front.title: Jaafar Jackson's 'Michael' biopic crosses $1 billion, beating his own goal
front.tldr: Two years before filming began, Jaafar Jackson wrote down a goal to beat 'Bohemian Rhapsody' and cross $1 billion at the box office playing his uncle in 'Michael.' He has done both.

front.title: Nvidia launches open models to run AI agents in the enterprise and on PCs
front.tldr: Nvidia released new open models aimed at running AI agents in corporate data centres and locally on PCs, as it leans into the shift toward private, on-device AI agents.

stories.title: Simon Willison on 'an obituary for programming'
stories.tldr: Simon Willison points to Jeremy Scheff's essay on how coding agents have taken away the puzzle-solving joy that drew many career programmers to the craft in the first place.

stories.title: Amazon takes aim at Nvidia with new TorchNeuron developer tool
stories.tldr: Amazon launched TorchNeuron, a tool meant to help developers run PyTorch, the free toolkit behind most AI apps, on its own chips rather than Nvidia's, challenging Nvidia's grip on the ecosystem.

stories.title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2 billion valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
stories.tldr: Nvidia challenger Tenstorrent raised $1.5 billion to remain independent after fielding acquisition interest earlier this year, lifting its valuation to $6.2 billion as it scales open-weight AI chips.

stories.title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
stories.tldr: Fed up with ads, tracking and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip out bloatware and take back control of their sets.

stories.title: Amazon to fund 12 small nuclear reactors at a former Indiana coal plant
stories.tldr: Amazon and X-energy have struck another deal to bring nuclear power to the grid, this time funding 12 small reactors expected to generate nearly a gigawatt of electricity.

stories.title: Rivian's CEO says autonomy will enable 'dramatically different' vehicle designs
stories.tldr: RJ Scaringe said he expects autonomous driving to let Rivian build vehicles radically different from the outdoorsy SUVs and trucks it currently makes.

stories.title: Laplace Intelligence red-teams robots and self-driving cars before they ship
stories.tldr: University of Michigan spinout Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and simulation to stress-test robots and self-driving vehicles before they reach the real world, and says it is already profitable.

stories.title: The mystery of Super Mario 64's cryptic plaque may finally be solved
stories.tldr: A message on a mysterious plaque in Super Mario 64 has puzzled the internet for 30 years, and Engadget reports we may finally know what it says.

stories.title: Apple acquired AI audio editing app Samplab
stories.tldr: Apple bought Samplab, an AI audio editing app that converts audio to MIDI with desktop and plugin tools, according to a European Commission notice. The deal closed back in June.

stories.title: HomePod software update adds a colourful 'Sound Glow' light show
stories.tldr: Apple's HomePod 27.2 update brings Sound Glow to the HomePod and HomePod mini, lighting up the speaker's touch surface with colours that match the album art of what's playing.

stories.title: Apple limits US iPhone Duo orders to two per customer
stories.tldr: Apple is capping iPhone Duo purchases at two per customer in the US; attempting to buy more via the website or Apple Store app triggers a limit notice.

stories.title: Kris Bowers to score Disney's animated feature 'Hexed'
stories.tldr: Oscar-winning composer Kris Bowers will score Disney's upcoming animated film 'Hexed,' which stars Hailee Steinfeld, Rashida Jones, Jodie Foster and Walton Goggins.

stories.title: Tom Hiddleston's new biopic is Apple TV's biggest streaming hit
stories.tldr: Tom Hiddleston's new 125-minute biographical film is drawing large audiences on Apple TV, where it has become the streaming service's biggest hit right now.

stories.title: Ken Russell's 'The Devils' sets return in new restoration
stories.tldr: A new restoration of Ken Russell's 'The Devils' spotlights production designer Derek Jarman's distinctive sets, which critics say remain unlike those of any other period film.

stories.title: Richard Riehle, 'Office Space' actor, dies at 78
stories.tldr: Richard Riehle, who played cynical manager Tom Smykowski in 'Office Space' and also appeared in 'Bridesmaids,' 'Casino' and 'The Fugitive,' has died at 78.

stories.title: Celtics will be near full strength for season opener against the Pistons
stories.tldr: Boston will be at near-full strength as it opens its season against the Detroit Pistons, with only Devin Carter listed as out.

stories.title: Patriots get mixed injury news ahead of Thursday's game in Chicago
stories.tldr: Morgan Moses has a chance of playing on Thursday night against the Bears, New England's latest injury update ahead of the trip to Chicago shows.

stories.title: Patriots place Romeo Doubs on injured reserve, sign Elliott Davison
stories.tldr: New England placed wide receiver Romeo Doubs on injured reserve and signed defensive back Elliott Davison to the 53-man roster from the practice squad, among several roster moves.

stories.title: How soon could Mercedes win the 2026 F1 constructors' title?
stories.tldr: Mercedes has dominated under F1's new 2026 regulations, and driver Kimi Antonelli could technically clinch the drivers' championship as early as this weekend's United States Grand Prix.

stories.title: Christian Horner says building Red Bull's F1 engine was 'scary as hell'
stories.tldr: Christian Horner said building Red Bull's in-house power unit from scratch was frightening, after the engine claimed its first race wins this season.

stories.title: Red Sox report cards show mixed grades across the roster
stories.tldr: Willson Contreras and Ceddanne Rafaela impressed in 2026, while veterans Trevor Story and Jarren Duran left a lot to be desired, Boston.com's season report cards found.

read.why: Today's Apple launch and the 'Michael' box-office win are both stories made bigger by marketing; Duolingo's growth playbook is the sharpest guide to doing that deliberately.
read.title: The secret to Duolingo’s exponential growth
read.subtitle: Don’t kill the golden goose, maintain a sense of urgency to drive compounding growth, copy first, and more of their biggest growth lessons

listen.title: Scott Wu, Cognition

listen.why: A masterclass in building a beloved, story-driven grocery brand without a single advert, pure product marketing territory for Damian.
listen.title: Trader Joe’s

finally.title: A tiny Game Boy emulator runs smoothly on an e-ink screen
finally.tldr: A software engineer built a Game Boy emulator that runs smoothly on a tiny e-ink display, impressive given how slowly e-paper screens normally refresh.
